name: Usagawa Yukiko
source:
Yukiko is [url=/c89999]Kuzumi Kiyoshirou[/url]'s senior in their high school and is a third-year student.

Her playful nature often leads her to engage in light-hearted banter with the protagonist and dote on him excessively. A keen photographer, she has an affinity for capturing felines on film, leading to her frequent recruitment for the school newspaper. With a laid-back attitude towards life, she relishes in the present rather than ruminating on the past or future.

Going home style: Group dynamic
As a regular member of her friends' extracurricular activities, it's not uncommon for Yukiko to return home with her companions. Although one-on-one time with the protagonist may be scarce, it is an enjoyable experience when they can create their own private world while going home together.
